result.summary: Several layout and overflow issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the screen edges, and a restaurant name is truncated.

issues.description: The last category chip in the horizontal filter row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the full set of categories is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding/inset and ensure the last chip can fully scroll into view (or wrap/peek with a clear fade).

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, and its name is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal carousel enough end padding so the last card is fully visible, and allow names to wrap or use a safer truncation (ellipsis) without cutting mid-word.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, so the listing looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards are not hidden behind the tab bar and users can see a full card before scrolling.
